title: Il posto migliore dove alloggiare: l'ordine degli aggettivi

sentences.it: Abbiamo soggiornato in un grande albergo moderno e costoso.
sentences.en: We stayed in an expensive large modern hotel.
alternatives: We stayed in an expensive big modern hotel.

sentences.it: Ho comprato un bel tavolo di legno rotondo.
sentences.en: I bought a beautiful round wooden table.
alternatives: I bought a nice round wooden table.
I've bought a beautiful round wooden table.

sentences.it: Mia nonna ha una vecchia borsa di pelle italiana.
sentences.en: My grandmother has an old Italian leather bag.
alternatives: My grandma has an old Italian leather bag.
My grandmother has got an old Italian leather bag.

sentences.it: Mi serve un sacco a pelo blu.
sentences.en: I need a blue sleeping bag.

sentences.it: Abbiamo visto una bellissima piccola chiesa greca.
sentences.en: We saw a beautiful small Greek church.
alternatives: We saw a beautiful little Greek church.

sentences.it: Hai mai soggiornato in un ostello?
sentences.en: Have you ever stayed in a hostel?

sentences.it: Qual è il tuo tipo di alloggio preferito e perché?
sentences.en: What is your favourite type of accommodation and why?
alternatives: What's your favourite type of accommodation and why?
What is your favorite type of accommodation and why?
What's your favorite type of accommodation and why?
Which is your favourite type of accommodation and why?

sentences.it: Le camere sono piccole ma pulite e comode.
sentences.en: The rooms are small but clean and comfortable.

sentences.it: L'albergo ha una piccola piscina rettangolare all'aperto.
sentences.en: The hotel has a small rectangular outdoor pool.
alternatives: The hotel has a small, rectangular outdoor pool.
The hotel has a small rectangular outdoor swimming pool.

sentences.it: Non è un albergo di lusso, ma è tranquillo ed elegante.
sentences.en: It's not a luxury hotel, but it's quiet and stylish.
alternatives: It isn't a luxury hotel, but it's quiet and stylish.
It is not a luxury hotel, but it is quiet and stylish.

sentences.it: C'è il Wi-Fi gratuito e una scrivania se devi lavorare.
sentences.en: There is free Wi-Fi and a desk if you need to work.
alternatives: There's free Wi-Fi and a desk if you need to work.
There is free Wi-Fi and a desk if you have to work.
There's free Wi-Fi and a desk if you have to work.

sentences.it: La piscina è perfetta per rinfrescarsi dopo una giornata impegnativa.
sentences.en: The pool is perfect to cool down after a busy day.
alternatives: The pool is perfect for cooling down after a busy day.

sentences.it: È perfetto per i giovani che non vogliono spendere troppi soldi.
sentences.en: It's perfect for young people who don't want to spend too much money.
alternatives: It is perfect for young people who don't want to spend too much money.
It is perfect for young people who do not want to spend too much money.

sentences.it: Il villaggio turistico ha una grande piscina blu.
sentences.en: The resort has a large blue pool.
alternatives: The resort has a big blue pool.
The resort has a large blue swimming pool.
The resort has a big blue swimming pool.

grammar.title: L'ordine degli aggettivi
grammar.body:
In inglese gli aggettivi vanno **prima del nome**, e quando sono più di uno seguono un **ordine preciso**:

| Ordine | Esempio |
| --- | --- |
| 1. opinione (*opinion*) | *beautiful* |
| 2. dimensione (*size*) | *large* |
| 3. età (*age*) | *old* |
| 4. forma (*shape*) | *square* |
| 5. colore (*colour*) | *blue* |
| 6. origine (*origin*) | *Greek* |
| 7. materiale (*material*) | *plastic* |
| 8. scopo (*purpose*) | *sleeping* |

- *We stayed in an **expensive large modern** hotel.* — opinione, dimensione, età.
- *The hotel has a **small, rectangular outdoor** pool.* — dimensione, forma, scopo.
- *a **beautiful round wooden** table* — opinione, forma, materiale.

In italiano l'ordine è spesso al contrario e gli aggettivi stanno anche dopo il nome: "un tavolo di legno rotondo" diventa *a round wooden table*.

L'aggettivo di **scopo** è quasi parte del nome e sta sempre per ultimo: *sleeping bag* (sacco a pelo), *swimming pool*.
